FN-L8K6YAA-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 284
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Jerry Starnes
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/19/2024
House Bill 284 as introduced could increase the obligations of certain institutions of higher
education by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of educational expenses of
veteran's dependents not reimbursed by the Alabama G.I. and Dependents Education Benefits
Program but that are offset or written-off pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
